show.description: A seemingly useless, game-addicted husband hiding behind jokes and laziness is secretly the legendary warrior “Star Lord” the missing leader of Agni Mahal , who must protect his wife’s empire, defeat powerful enemy clans, and reclaim his lost legacy before his enemies destroy everything he loves.
